finding.text: The new "Twins fold" table is not on either shot (requirement 2): the newest truth.jsonl line (2026-11-09 06:05 UTC) has no `fold` key, so `page.js` skips the block. Run `node Server/Truth.mjs --write` against the main tree (worktree `truth.jsonl` tail has no `fold` either), then reshoot — shots/127-0-0-1-49465-live-truth/1920.png, 400.png.

A merged record with no readable cost counts as "lost". `cache.jsonl` is gitignored, so `node Server/FoldAccounting.mjs` run inside the worktree prints `mismatched 404, lost 404, cost_after 0`; from the main tree (`--root C:/Code/lew42/monorepo`) it prints `matching 1408, mismatched 2, lost 0`. A null merged cost should read "unreadable", not lost, and Truth.mjs `--write` from a worktree would publish 404 losses. Say in both readmes that the check needs the main tree's caches.

The "reader" verdict only compares cache versions: session 05abc8e4 drops from $0.257 to $0 and is called `reader: merged cache is v2, half v1`. A recost to exactly zero is not a recost; that case (merged usd null/0) should count as lost or unreadable.
`Server/readme.md` lists every script (Truth.mjs at line 56, SessionConsolidate.mjs at line 55) but not `Server/FoldAccounting.mjs` or its test (law 11, readmes are the index).

A fresh agent can't continue from the task folder: it has no `plan.md` (brief-common asks for one), no log or decision lines, and no landing. session.jsonl ends with "session ended (other) without landing", and the totals and the mismatch answer the brief asks for are reported nowhere. Commit 321ddc843 on worktree/fold-accounting is the only record.

The brief says the halves' cost and tasks are "added together"; the code takes the larger half instead, because twins are two records of one session. The reason is in the code comment and the truth readme, but the owner should hear about this departure from their words in the report, not find it in code.
Every half has 0 tasks (`tasks_before 0`), so the task part of the check never fires on real data. Say so where the table is shown.
The CLI exits 1 when the only differences are reader differences (`mismatched 2, lost 0`). Exiting on `lost` would match the page's own "nothing lost" headline.
The moved-aside halves are shown as local paths, not links. That is unavoidable because they are outside the site, but requirement 2 asked for links, so state it.
